LLMNR.description: Enable or disable Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution (LLMNR). Use 'yes' to allow local hostname resolution via broadcast/multicast.

MulticastDNS.description: Enable or disable mDNS. Accepts 'yes' (respond to local queries), 'resolve' (forward queries to mDNS), or 'no' (disable).

DNSOverTLS.description: DNS-over-TLS mode. 'opportunistic' prefers encryption but falls back to plain DNS; 'yes' enforces TLS; 'no' disables DoT.

DNSSEC.description: DNSSEC validation mode. 'allow-downgrade' validates unless upstream doesn’t support it; 'true' requires validation; 'no' disables it.

DNSSecNegativeTrustAnchors.description: List of domains for which DNSSEC validation is explicitly disabled (e.g., internal zones without DNSSEC support).

items.description: Domain name to add to the negative trust anchor list.

DNS.description: Upstream DNS servers to use (IP addresses or resolvable hostnames). Systemd will prefer these over DHCP-provided servers unless overridden.

items.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) or hostname of a DNS server.

Domains.description: Search domains appended to unqualified hostnames during DNS lookups.

items.description: A domain name to include in DNS search paths.

DNSStubListener.description: If true, systemd-resolved provides a stub resolver at 127.0.0.53:53 for local services to query.

DNSStubListenerExtra.description: Additional IPs (e.g., IPv6 addresses or container IPs) where the DNS stub listener should bind. Useful in containerized environments.

items.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) to bind the DNS stub listener on, in addition to 127.0.0.53.

ReadResolvConf.description: If true, systemd-resolved reads and merges /etc/resolv.conf. Disable if you want systemd-resolved to fully manage DNS without legacy config interference.

Cache.description: DNS caching behavior. Set to 'yes' to enable (default size), or 'no' to disable caching.

DNSMaxPacketSize.description: Maximum DNS packet size (including EDNS0). Increase to 65535 if you rely on large DNS responses (e.g., DNSSEC with many records).

FallbackDNS.description: Fallback DNS servers used when no other DNS configuration is available (e.g., during early boot or without DHCP). Often used for private/reserved networks.

items.description: IP address of a fallback DNS server.

LLMNRPort.description: UDP port used for LLMNR traffic. Only change if port 5353 is unavailable.

MulticastDNSPort.description: UDP port used for mDNS traffic. Only change if port 5353 is unavailable.

LLMNRTimeoOut.description: Time in milliseconds to wait for LLMNR responses before giving up. Higher values improve reliability on slow networks.

MulticastDNSTimeoOut.description: Time in milliseconds to wait for mDNS responses before giving up. Higher values improve reliability on slow networks.
